summary_en: Asks if the folded unit fits a compact sedan trunk
text_en: Hi all, thinking about buying this for my mom. Does it fit in the trunk of a small sedan once folded? Also how heavy is it with the battery?

summary_en: Unboxing and first week with the unit
text_en: Unboxed mine today. Assembly took about ten minutes. Seat is comfortable and my dad says it feels steady on the sidewalk.

summary_en: Asks how to adjust the braking sensitivity
text_en: Is there a way to make the brake less sudden? It stops very quickly when I let go of the lever.

summary_en: Controller shows an error code after two weeks
text_en: Mine started showing an error on the display after two weeks and now the chair will not move. Support asked for a video.

summary_en: Announces a firmware update and how to install it
text_en: Firmware update available. Please follow the steps in the pinned guide and contact support if the update fails.

summary_en: Took the scooter on a weekend trip
text_en: Took it in the trunk for a weekend trip. Folding was easy and we used it all day at the botanical garden.

summary_en: Battery drains faster than the rated range
text_en: The rated range is far from what I get. Two hours of errands and I am almost out of charge.

summary_en: Applies for the beta program
text_en: I use a manual chair now but my shoulders hurt. I would love to test a compact power chair and give feedback.

summary_en: Wants a basket and a cane holder
text_en: Love the scooter, but please add a basket and a place to rest my cane. I shop every morning.

summary_en: Seat height adjustment works well
text_en: The seat height adjustment is great. My wife is short and it finally fits her.

summary_en: Handle screws loosen after daily use
text_en: The handle screws keep coming loose. I tightened them three times this month.

summary_en: Asks whether it is allowed on trains and planes
text_en: Can I take this on a train or a plane? I could not find any rules on the website.

summary_en: Asks about climbing small curbs
text_en: Will it climb a two-inch curb? I keep getting stuck at my driveway.

summary_en: Thanks the group for tips
text_en: Thanks everyone for the tips on tire pressure. Rides are smoother now.

summary_en: Arrived with a damaged control arm
text_en: Package arrived with a bent control arm. The box was clearly dropped.

summary_en: Rides well on gravel and grass
text_en: Took it on the gravel path at the park. No issues, felt stable.

summary_en: Compares with a lighter competitor
text_en: How does this compare to the folding scooters from other brands? I need something under 40 pounds.

summary_en: Suggests a carry handle in the middle
text_en: Please put the carry handle at the center. Right now the weight pulls forward when I lift it.

summary_en: Asks how to fold the rollator
text_en: How do I fold it? The lever seems stuck.

summary_en: Waited 10 days for a replacement part
text_en: Still waiting for the replacement part. It has been ten days with no update.

summary_en: Uses the chair at work every day
text_en: The chair fits under my desk and I can finally stay out of pain through the workday.

summary_en: Announces a new accessory bundle
text_en: New accessory bundle is available. Check the pinned post for details.

summary_en: Range is lower in cold weather
text_en: Range drops almost by half when it gets cold.

summary_en: Considers the unit good value
text_en: For the weight and price this is a great deal. I can lift it myself into the car.

summary_en: Asks about charging time
text_en: How long does a full charge take, and can I leave it plugged in overnight?

summary_en: Volunteers to test a new release
text_en: I would like to join the next test round. I travel often and can report on airport use.

summary_en: Wants a cup holder and a bag hook
text_en: Please add a cup holder and a bag hook. Small things, but they matter every day.

summary_en: Flat tire and no way to repair at home
text_en: Flat tire. I cannot push it and I cannot carry it. Does anyone know a repair shop?

summary_en: Feels safer than a cane
text_en: The brakes make me feel much safer on slopes than my old walker.

summary_en: Asks about shipping time and return policy
text_en: What is the delivery time to the West Coast? And what is the return policy if it does not fit?

summary_en: Likes the ride but the seat squeaks
text_en: Ride is smooth but the seat squeaks over bumps.
